＊Eiji＊＠０６０＿００４Say, Elan's a lot like Earth and￥all, but are the animals really￥that similar too?
＊Yoh＊＠０６０＿００５That's what the survey reports￥say so far, anyway.
＊Yoh＊＠０６０＿００６But when we actually see them,￥they might be quite different...
＊Natsuno＊＠０６０＿００７True. With only the data we have￥now, it's still just guesswork.

＊Yoh＊＠０６０＿０１０...Come on, man...￥No way.

＊Kairi＊＠０６０＿０１５But they're right. That can't￥possibly be all there is...＝＠０６０＿０１６An interesting topic...

Let's go join them.

＊Eiji＊＠０６０＿０２０But c'mon, wouldn't it be cool￥if there were some weird￥creatures out there?
＊Kairi＊＠０６０＿０２１As everyone knows by now, Elan￥closely resembles Earth.

＊Kairi＊＠０６０＿０２２If the data's that similar, then￥Elan's life forms will almost￥certainly resemble Earth's too.＝＠０６０＿０２３But nature can go beyond common￥sense, and beyond science.＝＠０６０＿０２４A detailed survey on site may￥well turn up creatures unlike￥anything we've ever seen.
＊Yoh＊＠０６０＿０２６That's rare. Kairi joining in.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６０＿０２７Come to think of it, we've never￥really talked, have we?
＊Kairi＊＠０６０＿０２８That... may be true.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６１＿００１Oh, I know! Since Kairi's here,￥let's ask him.＝＠０６１＿００２You just said we might find￥creatures unlike anything we've￥ever seen, right?
＊Natsuno＊＠０６１＿００３If they really exist, what would￥they be like? Scientifically,￥what can you imagine?
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿００４Fantasy isn't science, but...＝＠０６１＿００５Given the stable, warm climate,￥there could be some very large￥land animals.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６１＿００６So there might be dinosaurs,￥like a Tyrannosaurus!
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿００７Ah, er, yes.￥That's certainly possible...
＊Yoh＊＠０６１＿００８So Kairi reacts like that too!｝￥＠０６１＿００９You seem a lot more laid-back￥than before.
＊Yoh＊＠０６１＿０１０Wonder who we have to thank~
＊Yoh＊＠０６１＿０１１Well, we're done eating,￥so we'll get going.＝＠０６１＿０１２That was fun, you two.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６１＿０１３See you! Next time,￥let's all eat together!
＊Eiji＊＠０６１＿０１４Later!
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０１５Ah, yes...＝...＝＠０６１＿０１６I'm a little tired...

Yeah, it is!
You didn't know that?
Yes, isn't it!
You didn't know that?
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０１８People respond in ways I'd never￥expect. It's fascinating.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０１９No. I've never talked with￥people like this before.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２０I've learned they see things￥from a different viewpoint than￥mine. It's fascinating.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２１Except for you, I barely talked￥to anyone unless I had to.￥So I never knew.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２２You said talking with others was￥important, so I wanted to find￥out for myself.
Because I said so...?
Why only now?
Because I said so...?
Why only now?
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２３Yes. Otherwise, I don't think it￥would have occurred to me to￥try to find out.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２４Let's see... I suppose because I￥was only interested in research.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２５Until now, I was in a place￥where focusing only on research￥was never a problem...＝＠０６１＿０２６And I was satisfied with that.￥But now...
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２７I've learned that hearing other￥people's ideas is full of￥discoveries. It's fun.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２８People are so varied. When you￥engage them, they surprise you.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０２９Fascinating, just like nature...￥And I never knew it until now.
＊Kairi＊＠０６１＿０３０I've been missing out a bit...
